scope: 77 TRAIN designs/4454 existing physical clips only; reserved selection/calibration/test untouched. No structural regeneration, new architecture, blend-weight sweep, deployment noise assumption or true-margin routing. Exploratory OOF selection is not independent structural validation.

fitting: Original32->16 ReLU MLP alpha1, native LBFGS max_iter10000/max_fun200000/tol1e-7, seeds42/43/44, original5 design folds, train-only scaling/inactive mask. exploration: All21 cached conditions: prior15 plus blend verification6, including clean, iid1/5, correlated1, residual channel gain and reported dt+/-2%. Summarize global design MAE, stable/unstable last.01/.02/.05, signed-error/exceedance curves, farther-stable m>=.15, train-versus-held-out and per-seed/fold consistency. Fixed-prediction whole-design paired2000 resamples, no refit/seed uncertainty or multiplicity correction.
diagnostics: Replay clean, independent1/5 at white939/941 and correlated1 at shared940/942. Check original174-feature replay. Estimated modal count/fit residual/usable prefix, visibility count, alpha gap, relative frequency gap, second energy, similarity and validity; solver-pole Hungarian frequency recovery and selected first/second truth identities used ONLY for diagnostics. Compare repeated-draw prediction variance, systematic bias, sign disagreement, training and OOF errors, and recovery/quality cohorts. No solver truth in feature selection, model inputs, warning calibration or candidate selection.
hypotheses: Noisy pole identity or second-mode recovery predicts boundary degradation
One ingredient or interaction carries gains while another causes harm
Availability rather than detailed patterns explains some gains
Boundary damage persists in training and good-recovery cohorts, supporting a fitting/representation tradeoff rather than recovery failure alone
selection: After exploratory matrix summaries, lock up to2 reduced finalists (excluding PCS). Eligibility: mean global design MAE over latest6 cached verification conditions <=one-mode mean. Sort eligible by count of positive one-mode-relative stable last1% MAE/stable sign/unstable sign/far-under>.05 point changes on four latest1% conditions, then same count on two5% conditions, then mean global MAE, then name. If no eligible reduced variant, lock the least-global-MAE reduced variant as a diagnostic finalist, explicitly ineligible, not a qualified survivor. This fallback completes controls/confirmation without claiming a success. Lock names/model hashes before any new confirmation outcomes.
controls: For each locked reduced finalist fit a same-width control: permute ALL selected added columns jointly within outer training/held-out source-row sets separately, same mapping across views/MLP seeds, seed934+fold; original107 remain aligned. Nondeployable sham may create inconsistent combinations; compare real finalist to both sham and frozen references.
confirmation: After finalist lock, new iid/correlated1% and5% at white943/shared944 and white945/shared946:8 conditions. Same original-eight RMS; rho.8 pre-calibration shared noise. Levels share each realization for paired stress comparison. No fitting/search on these draws. Confirm locked reduced variants and one-mode/full174/blend50; evaluate shams too. Report failures separately, not averaged away.
acceptance: Zero allowed deterioration for formal noninferiority: upper paired95% bound <=0 versus one-mode for stable last1% design MAE, stable/unstable last1% wrong-sign rates and farther-stable under>.05, in EVERY new1/5 iid/correlated condition. Require global MAE paired upper bound<0 versus one-mode in every condition; disclose comparison to blend and full174. No inconclusive interval treated as noninferiority. Matched-control global gain must have upper bound<0 on new1% conditions. This conservative research criterion is not a deployment-derived safety margin; no candidate may pass. Report descriptive point checks separately. No deployment/default adoption.
warning: Separate warning study for frozen references and locked finalists. For every outer fold, split its training DESIGNS into proper-fit/calibration subsets: shuffled unique IDs seed947+outer_fold; calibration ceil(.2*n_training_designs), remainder proper-fit. All noise copies stay together. Fit SAME fixed MLP on proper-fit only; calibrate thresholds on design-disjoint calibration predictions pooled across four original training noise views. Native models paired by seed; blend pairs proper-fit107 and174. Thresholds for empirical stable false-warning budgets1/5/10/20%, using largest threshold below next sorted stable score (nextafter handles ties) with observed calibration rate<=budget. Apply these SAME proper-fit predictors/thresholds to outer-held-out new confirmation conditions; never transfer thresholds onto full-training refits. Unsafe label m<=0; warning if prediction<=threshold. Report false-warning/missed-unstable clip rates, last1% slices and zero-threshold references. No operational event/lead-time claim or conformal guarantee; no threshold chosen on test outcomes.
timing: Warm single-thread full raw25-channel-to-prediction on77 fixed first-row/design clips from new iid1_seed943,10 repetitions, rotating arm order. One calibration/ONE modal estimate; share full feature vector when blending, use declared column subsets for reduced models. Saved seed42/fold0 predictors as timing vehicles. Include feature extraction/train-fold transforms/native forwards, exclude acquisition/noise generation/disk/startup. Check feature/prediction replay. Report median/p95/max/paired overhead;10ms p95 is reported as an engineering screen, not hard-real-time proof.
interventions: No new reliability gate or weighted loss is automatically added. Use ingredient/diagnostic results to state whether removal of a harmful block, observable reliability weighting, targeted fitting or warning calibration is supported; if evidence cannot choose, record that limitation. GRU remains a later improved-representation comparison.
